claims: The U.S. stock market (NYSE and Nasdaq) is closed on Friday, April 3, 2026, in observation of Good Friday.
The U.S. stock market (NYSE and Nasdaq) will reopen for normal hours on Monday, April 6, 2026.
The bond market closes early at 12 p.m. ET on Friday, April 3, 2026.
The London Stock Exchange is closed on Friday, April 3, 2026.
The Hong Kong Stock Exchange is closed on Friday, April 3, 2026.
Markets are closed on Saturday, April 4, 2026, and Sunday, April 5, 2026.
The next scheduled market closure is on Monday, May 25, 2026, for Memorial Day.
